prompt: Write a ~700-word professional workplace message about: announcing a change to the meeting schedule. Plain prose.
text:
**Subject: Update on Upcoming Meeting Schedule**

Dear Team,

As we approach the midpoint of the quarter, I wanted to take a moment to discuss our upcoming meeting schedule and make an important announcement regarding some changes that will be taking place.

As you are aware, our team has been meeting bi-weekly for the past several months to review progress, discuss ongoing projects, and set goals for the weeks ahead. However, given the current state of our project portfolios and the increasing complexity of our workloads, I have decided to adjust our meeting schedule to better accommodate the needs of our team.

Beginning immediately, we will be moving from bi-weekly meetings to weekly check-ins on Thursdays at 2:00 PM. This change is intended to provide more frequent opportunities for us to discuss and address challenges as they arise, while also allowing for greater flexibility in planning and prioritizing tasks.

In addition to the schedule change, I would like to announce that our meeting format will also be adjusted to better support our team's needs. Going forward, we will be adopting a hybrid approach, where we will combine virtual and in-person participation as necessary. This means that some team members may join meetings remotely while others are present in person. I encourage everyone to make arrangements for remote participation whenever possible to accommodate colleagues who may need to attend from off-site locations.

To ensure a smooth transition into this new schedule, please note the following:

* The first meeting under the new format will take place on Thursday at 2:00 PM and will be held in Conference Room A.
* All team members are expected to participate remotely via video conferencing software for their first meeting unless they have made prior arrangements with their manager or the project lead.
* If you are unable to attend a meeting in person, please make sure to notify your team lead and manager in advance so that we can make necessary accommodations.

To facilitate this transition, I would like to ask each of you to review our current projects and update our shared project management tool with any outstanding issues or concerns by the end of this week. This will enable us to address these matters promptly during our first meeting under the new schedule.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding the changes to our meeting schedule, please do not hesitate to reach out to me or your team lead. We are committed to ensuring that this transition is as seamless as possible and that we maintain our high level of productivity and collaboration throughout.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in this matter. I look forward to seeing each of you on Thursday at 2:00 PM for our first meeting under the new schedule.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Team Lead
